metadata.title: World Digest — November 5, 2026
metadata.summary: Trump-era market rally fades into a divided Congress as Democrats flip the House, while ANC collapse and Sony's profit surge reshape global headlines.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
1. Midterm earthquake: Republicans lose House, Speaker Johnson steps aside

Democrats flipped control of the U.S. House, with Speaker Mike Johnson announcing he will not stay on as Republican leader after sweeping GOP losses NBC News. Republicans also lost their supermajority in Utah Utah News Dispatch and South Carolina WLTX, while Texas saw stunning defeats KSAT, and Democrats are set to launch probes as the party faces a succession fight Federal News Network. NBC News Utah News Dispatch WLTX KSAT Federal News Network

2. South Africa's ANC suffers historic vote-share collapse

South Africa's ruling African National Congress saw its vote share tumble, a result Reuters calls the party's "worst nightmare" Reuters. The decline threatens the ANC's long-held dominance and could reshape national politics. Reuters

3. Oregon school shooting: Suspect identified

Police identified the suspect in the Bend, Oregon, school shooting, saying the individual previously attended the elementary school where the attack occurred ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos. The incident has renewed focus on school safety. ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos

4. Sony raises profit outlook on strong demand

Sony Group lifted its FY 2026 net profit outlook to 1.33 trillion yen, a positive signal for the global tech and entertainment giant Japan Wire by Kyodo News. The upgrade reflects robust underlying performance. Japan Wire by Kyodo News

5. Maryland stabbing: One in custody, three injured

One person is in custody and three others were injured in a Randallstown apartment stabbing WBAL-TV. The incident is under investigation. WBAL-TV

6. Bronx subway shooting injures 25-year-old man

A 25-year-old man was shot at the Tremont Ave B/D platform in the Bronx ABC7 New York. The motive and circumstances remain unclear. ABC7 New York

7. Record-breaking floods hit Twin Cities

Record water levels caused flooding in the Twin Cities area, disrupting communities and prompting emergency responses News Observer, Blue Ridge, Georgia. News Observer, Blue Ridge, Georgia

8. Trump faces post-midterm turmoil

After the GOP losses, Donald Trump faces scrutiny over Democratic probes and an emerging race to succeed him as party leader Federal News Network. Federal News Network

9. NFL trade deadline: Ravens land Jacoby Brissett

The Baltimore Ravens are finalizing a trade for Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett, per reports WBAL-TV. The move reshapes the QB depth chart. WBAL-TV

10. Wildfire season closes with record damage

Oregon's Department of Forestry looked back on the record-breaking 2026 fire season, with officials saying crews "gave it all they had" KTVZ. The season’s scale strained resources. KTVZ

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

Joshua Wong, Hong Kong democracy activist, was sentenced to an additional 10 years in prison, drawing international condemnation from figures including a top US Republican The Hill NPR. In the US, President Trump's midterm losses prompted mixed reactions from foreign leaders PBS. Ukraine's President Zelensky pleaded for air defenses after a Russian attack on an aid center possibly killed 70 CBS News. Indonesia deployed 20,000 troops amid a wiretap scandal involving President Prabowo Bloomberg.com. The EU stated Montenegro is on track to join by 2028 DW.com.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets

US equities rallied as traders bet a Democratic midterm sweep would slow Big Tech AI spending Bloomberg.com. Defense stocks sold off on Pentagon budget concerns TWZ.

Commodities: Gold topped $4,100 as the dollar and Treasury yields fell post-election Barron's.

Corporate News: - CVS announced a breakup, splitting off its drugstore business The Economist. - Qualcomm shares slid after weak Q1 guidance on squeezed chip margins Yahoo Finance. - Sony profits surged on Spider-Man film and PlayStation sales The Verge. - Amazon tapped Uber Eats for Prime, replacing Grubhub TechCrunch. - Agility Robotics debuted on Nasdaq as the first pure humanoid robot stock TechCrunch. - Trump Media (DJT) crashed, erasing $168 million from his net worth Benzinga.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content:
Entertainment

'Godzilla Minus Zero' is eyeing a $60M worldwide opening while 'Ramayana' launches huge, dividing critics in India's costliest film Deadline BBC. Adam Driver confirmed his 'Heat 2' villain role, noting Michael Mann was "at work the next day" after an accidental shooting IGN. Skydance reorganized its TV and streaming distribution leadership post-merger, with eight executives exiting Variety.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Basketball

  • San Antonio Spurs 112, Dallas Mavericks 111: Wembanyama posted career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds to hold off Dallas ESPN.
  • Los Angeles Lakers 116, Sacramento Kings 103: Luka Doncic's 40 points carried the Lakers ESPN. Oklahoma City Thunder 124, Cleveland Cavaliers 116: Gilgeous-Alexander scored 42 ESPN.
  • Philadelphia 76ers 112, Detroit Pistons 106: Jaylen Brown's season-high 30 and a key block kept Philadelphia rolling ESPN.

Hockey

  • Los Angeles Kings 7, San Jose Sharks 2: Adrian Kempe recorded a hat trick and an assist, with Quinton Byfield adding two goals ESPN.
  • Ottawa Senators 2, Buffalo Sabres 1: Amadio scored with just over three minutes left ESPN.

Soccer

  • Crystal Palace's appeal over Jean-Philippe Mateta's red card was rejected, triggering a three-match ban ESPN.

sections.title: Music Releases
sections.content:
Albums & EPs

  • Duki — A Veces Solo Me Divierto Spotify: Argentine trap star returns with a 12-track set, a major Latin release of the day.
  • Elissa — Elissar Spotify: The Lebanese diva drops a 14-track album, a key pan-Arab pop moment.
  • Armin van Buuren — ASOT 1302 Spotify: The trance titan’s weekly radio show arrives as an 89-track compilation, including 2008 highlights.
  • Stixx — Destiny Spotify: A 20-track project, one of several hip-hop releases this week alongside BigXthaPlug’s BETTER OVER TIME Spotify.

Singles

  • Ado — Shinka Spotify: The Japanese vocal powerhouse’s new single.
  • Pritam, Asrar, Arma — Afghan Jalebi (Multilingual Version) Spotify: A new take on the Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani hit.
  • Anelia & Michalis Hatzigiannis — Не тръгвай Spotify: A Bulgarian-Greek cross-border collaboration.
  • Masoom Sharma — Badmashan Spotify: New Haryanvi track featuring Rahul Chhachhia and Swara Verma.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

OPay Limited priced on the NYSE at $19 Yahoo Finance. Upcoming listings include Hilton Worldwide (Nasdaq, Nov 5) Yahoo Finance, Interpace Biosciences (Nasdaq, Nov 6) Yahoo Finance, and Deep Sea Minerals (Nasdaq, Nov 10) Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

The Dow jumped 3.03% and the S&P 500 gained 1.58%, while the Nasdaq rose 1.44% Yahoo Finance. The Russell 2000 added 1.58% Yahoo Finance. The VIX plummeted 20.26% to 16.61, signaling a sharp drop in volatility Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Consumer Discretionary led with a 4.26% surge, followed by Financials (+3.51%) and Communication Services (+3.47%) Yahoo Finance. Energy lagged sharply, falling 4.74% Yahoo Finance. Technology was flat (-0.01%) Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Microsoft surged 6.68% and Amazon rose 6.12% Yahoo Finance. Apple climbed 5.31%, while JPMorgan gained 4.18% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia fell 3.17% and Tesla dropped 3.34% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

No individual movers were provided beyond index and sector data.

Rates & Commodities

The 10-year yield fell 1.17% to 4.89% Yahoo Finance. WTI crude plunged 8.29% to $88.12 Yahoo Finance. Gold jumped 3.37% to $4,073, and Bitcoin rose 3.96% to $80,405 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • Markets digest Democratic House sweep; AI capex slowdown bets may extend Big Tech rotation, while defense names face continued pressure
  • Trump succession jockeying intensifies; watch for early probes announcement
  • ANC collapse could trigger coalition talks, affecting rand and investor confidence

Next Week

  • Hilton, Interpace, Deep Sea Minerals listings test IPO demand post-election
  • Oregon wildfire and Minnesota flood recovery dominate regional agendas

Next Month

  • Sony’s raised outlook may signal broader tech earnings resilience; CVS breakup could catalyze retail-health sector restructuring
